info.name: EventMitra API
info.description: Main-module permission flow: login as your super admin, create role, create admin with that role, create main module, assign per-admin flags, and save the matrix. Login and auth/me return effective module permissions. No submodules. Codes are generated. Credentials remain empty in the local environment. Permission POST accepts an object or array and upserts existing rows. Login accepts email or username. New admins require admin_username. Names and identities are checked for duplicates. Migration 014: admin user/owner CRUD and bank account add/list/get/update are in a separate folder. Ordinary admins require user_management/owner_management module actions; super admins have access. Migration 015 venue/configuration APIs are included in a separate folder; set venue_name and admin venue_owner_id. Slots, decorations, meals and prices now use a single POST save endpoint with an optional record ID for updates. Null venue child record IDs create new rows; populated IDs update existing rows. Separate child PUT routes are removed. Three venue-scoped price dropdowns provide slot, decoration and meal options. Migration 018: owner signup requires unique user_name; owner_name may repeat. Login uses email or user_name. Verification purpose OTP creates a bearer session; password-reset proof does not. Migration 019 adds venue_address. Shared authenticated multipart upload: POST /api/uploads. Migration 020 adds is_default (false on insert), one fallback per venue/slot, and booking_date price resolution for user venue search/detail, quote and creation. Full endpoint changes: docs/default-venue-pricing.md.

request.description: identifier accepts email or username. You may instead send email or username, but provide exactly one login field. Usernames contain no spaces. Set admin_login in the environment; legacy admin_email is used as a fallback.
